missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: Voting result 3/3 for NO_MISSING_HIGH_LEVEL_GOALS. The project description explicitly lists the following functional requirements: 1) Users search for nearby centers by zip code, view operational hours, and access maps (covered by 'Discover suitable recycling facilities efficiently'); 2) Users receive notifications about events (covered by 'Stay informed about recycling-related events and updates'); 3) Administrators manage facility information (covered by 'Maintain accurate and up-to-date recycling facility information'); 4) Administrators manage user feedback (covered by 'Address user feedback effectively to improve the service'); 5) Administrators ensure data security (covered by 'Ensure the security and integrity of system data'); 6) Facility representatives communicate with admins to provide/update info (covered by 'Provide accurate and timely information about their recycling facility' and 'Collaborate with administrators to ensure correct facility representation'). All explicit actor-level responsibilities are entailed by the current HLGs. No missing goals.
